task_description: Add timezone-aware timestamp formatting utilities to src/observeco/dashboard/__init__.py and replace user-facing strftime calls across the dashboard routes to use them.
task: Add timezone-aware timestamp formatting utility functions to the file src/observeco/dashboard/__init__.py at the current location (the repository you are working in): at least _local_tz, _tz_abbr, _fmt_dt, and _fmt_now. Then replace user-facing strftime calls across the dashboard route files to use these utilities. Work only within the current repository directory — do not look outside it for another copy.
